value.name: Winner's Curse
value.definition: Picking the best of many noisy measurements inflates its score, so the winner underperforms on fresh data.
value.in_this_source: The validation-best checkpoint scored 1,173.3 on validation seeds but 912.0 on the official five, so the author submitted the final network instead.

value.name: Eval Leakage
value.definition: Test prompts or answers leaking into training data, which inflates evaluation scores without real learning.
value.in_this_source: The brief threatens a substantial grade penalty if eval prompts, answer keys, or eval outputs are included in the training corpus.

value.name: Ablation
value.definition: An experiment that removes or changes one factor while holding the rest fixed, to see what that factor contributes.
value.in_this_source: Experiment C trains on the same words as B with the sentences split apart, which separates vocabulary coverage from pattern learning.

value.name: Out-of-Vocabulary Cases
value.definition: Test cases containing words the model never learned, which it cannot score.
value.in_this_source: A case whose prompt or answer choice has a word outside the learned vocabulary is marked out_of_vocabulary and scores zero in the all-case rate.

value.name: Next-Token Scoring
value.definition: Grading a language model by which candidate word it assigns the highest next-token probability.
value.in_this_source: Each case feeds a prefix to the trained nanoGPT and scores it correct if the right word has the highest probability among four candidates.

value.name: Margin
value.definition: The probability of the correct choice minus the probability of the best wrong choice.
value.in_this_source: Margin = p(correct) - p(best wrong choice), averaged over the 3 cases, reported per seed for negation and spatial.

value.name: UI State Handling
value.definition: Designing distinct loading, empty, success, and error views so every request outcome is visible to the user.
value.in_this_source: The brief requires friendly loading, empty, success, and error states, and treating status 409 as 'That name is already signed up.'

value.name: Public Unauthenticated API
value.definition: An endpoint anyone can call without credentials, acceptable only for non-sensitive data.
value.in_this_source: The signup API deliberately has no login, class code, or API key, and the brief warns not to reuse the pattern for private or sensitive data.

value.name: Dependency Injection
value.definition: Passing a component its collaborators as arguments instead of having it reach for globals.
value.in_this_source: api.ts takes fetch as an optional injected argument, which lets the tests exercise every status code without stubbing globals.

value.name: XSS Prevention
value.definition: Rendering untrusted input as literal text (e.g. the DOM textContent property, never innerHTML) so injected markup cannot run.
value.in_this_source: render.ts inserts every name with textContent because anyone can write to the endpoint; a test asserts an name renders as literal text.
